items.title: Agentic AppSec: Software Development Went Agentic. Security Didn’t.
items.summary: AI-driven development is outpacing traditional security workflows. Snyk’s Agentic AppSec uses security agents to find, fix, and verify vulnerabilities continuously, while humans set the bar.

items.title: VulnBump: Can AI Agents Fix Vulnerable Dependencies Without Breaking the Build?
